name: HVAC & Ventilation
summary: Chilled-water plants, VRF and packaged systems, smoke control and kitchen exhaust — sized, balanced and commissioned.
description: From the first heat-load run to the final balancing report, our mechanical team designs, supplies and installs air-conditioning and ventilation that hits design conditions on handover day — not after six months of call-backs. We prefabricate ductwork in our 10th of Ramadan workshop and test every AHU before it leaves.
scope: Heat-load calculations and equipment selection
Chillers, cooling towers, AHUs, FCUs and VRF systems
Ductwork fabrication, insulation and installation
Car-park ventilation, stair pressurisation and smoke extraction
Testing, adjusting and balancing (TAB) with signed reports

name: Electrical Power & Lighting
summary: MV/LV distribution, generators, UPS, lighting and controls, earthing and lightning protection.
description: We build power systems that utilities approve first time and facility teams can maintain: clear single-line diagrams, labelled panels, selective protection and full test documentation. Our electrical engineers coordinate directly with the distribution company so energisation never waits on paperwork.
scope: Medium-voltage switchgear and transformer rooms
Main and sub-main LV distribution boards
Standby generators, ATS and UPS systems
Interior, exterior and emergency lighting with controls
Earthing, lightning protection and power-quality studies
metricLabel: standby power on a single site

name: Plumbing & Drainage
summary: Water supply and booster sets, hot water, drainage and venting, lift stations and water treatment.
description: Water systems fail quietly and expensively. We size risers and booster sets from real demand profiles, pressure-test every zone before close-up, and hand over isometric as-builts so leaks can be traced in minutes rather than days.
scope: Domestic cold and hot water networks with booster pumps
Solar and heat-pump hot-water systems
Soil, waste, vent and storm drainage
Sewage lift stations and grease interceptors
Water treatment, filtration and irrigation
metricLabel: water treated for a single resort

name: Fire Fighting & Fire Alarm
summary: Sprinklers, hydrants, fire pumps, clean-agent suppression and addressable fire alarm with voice evacuation.
description: Life-safety systems are where shortcuts cost the most. Our licensed fire team handles hydraulic calculations, Civil Defence submittals and witness testing, then trains your facility staff on the panels they will actually use.
scope: Hydraulically calculated sprinkler systems
Fire pumps (electric, diesel, jockey) and fire water tanks
Landing valves, hose reels and external hydrants
FM-200 / Novec clean-agent suppression for critical rooms
Addressable fire alarm and voice evacuation systems

name: Low Current & ELV
summary: Structured cabling, CCTV, access control, public address, nurse call and IPTV — one integrated backbone.
description: Modern buildings run on low-current systems as much as on power. We design one coordinated ELV backbone instead of six separate contractors' cables, then integrate CCTV, access control and fire alarm so security teams work from a single screen.
scope: Structured cabling (Cat 6A and fibre backbones)
IP CCTV with video analytics
Access control, intercom and visitor management
Public address and background music
Nurse call, IPTV and MATV systems
metricLabel: of data cabling on a single campus

name: BMS & Energy Management
summary: Building management systems, energy metering and commissioning that keep running costs visible.
description: A building is only as efficient as the controls that run it. We integrate chillers, AHUs, lighting and meters into one BMS, tune the sequences during seasonal commissioning, and leave owners with dashboards that show where every kilowatt-hour goes.
scope: BMS design, programming and graphics
BACnet / Modbus integration of third-party plant
Sub-metering for energy, water and chilled water
Seasonal commissioning and retro-commissioning
Energy audits with payback-ranked recommendations
